title: 資料庫交易與日誌
summary: 以ACID、MVCC 與可復原日誌連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect acid, mvcc and recoverable logging through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 交易與隔離
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「交易與隔離」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop transactions and isolation through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: ACID 分離：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「ACID 分離」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for acid separation.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ACID 分離」的資料、控制與時間關係。原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將假想失敗對應各屬性。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acid separation. Atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Map fictional failures to properties. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 將假想失敗對應各屬性。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：MVCC 等於所有交易均為 serializable。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: MVCC makes every transaction serializable. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「ACID 分離」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit acid separation two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: ACID 分離的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。
knowledge.textEn: Atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability differ.

knowledge.title: ACID 分離的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 將假想失敗對應各屬性。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Map fictional failures to properties. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設每批 fsync=4 ms 且一次序列寫入，單筆提交理想上界 250 commits/s；每批 20 交易的 group commit 為 5000 transactions/s，上界未含日誌流量、鎖與排隊延遲。
knowledge.textEn: With assumed 4 ms serial fsync, one transaction/batch has an ideal 250 commits/s bound. Twenty transactions/group yields 5000 transactions/s, excluding log bandwidth, locks and queueing.

quiz.question: 本步審查「ACID 分離」與整體「資料庫交易與日誌」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing acid separation within database transactions and logging, which statement or check is supported?
options: 原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。
MVCC 等於所有交易均為 serializable。
資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。
optionsEn: Atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability differ.
MVCC makes every transaction serializable.
Durable pages before their logs satisfy WAL.
quiz.explanation: 原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。 將假想失敗對應各屬性。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability differ. Map fictional failures to properties. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: ACID 分離：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「將假想失敗對應各屬性。」檢查「ACID 分離」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for acid separation using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「ACID 分離」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：將假想失敗對應各屬性。 核對「原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for acid separation and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Map fictional failures to properties. Check the principle: Atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability differ. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 將假想失敗對應各屬性。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：MVCC 等於所有交易均為 serializable。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: MVCC makes every transaction serializable. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「ACID 分離」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「將假想失敗對應各屬性。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit acid separation input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: 異常分類：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「異常分類」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for anomaly classification.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「異常分類」的資料、控制與時間關係。髒讀、不可重複讀與幻讀不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「用兩會話紙上時序分類。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for anomaly classification. Dirty, nonrepeatable and phantom reads differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify paper traces of two sessions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 用兩會話紙上時序分類。
steps.observationEn: Classify paper traces of two sessions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Durable pages before their logs satisfy WAL. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「異常分類」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「髒讀、不可重複讀與幻讀不同。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit anomaly classification two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

steps.title: 異常分類：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「用兩會話紙上時序分類。」檢查「異常分類」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for anomaly classification using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「異常分類」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：用兩會話紙上時序分類。 核對「髒讀、不可重複讀與幻讀不同。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for anomaly classification and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Classify paper traces of two sessions. Check the principle: Dirty, nonrepeatable and phantom reads differ. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 用兩會話紙上時序分類。
steps.observationEn: Classify paper traces of two sessions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Durable pages before their logs satisfy WAL. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「異常分類」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「用兩會話紙上時序分類。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit anomaly classification input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
